## 变更 / Change

<!-- 用中英任一语言说明问题、实现与用户影响。 / Describe the problem, implementation, and user impact in either Chinese or English. -->

## 验证 / Verification

<!-- 列出实际运行的命令与未验证边界。 / List the commands actually run and every unverified boundary. -->

## 来源确认 / Source declaration

- [ ] 本变更由本人原创，或已列明其依据的公开 DSH/pi-ai/OpenAI 合同与可复现黑盒观察。 / I authored this change or identified every public DSH/pi-ai/OpenAI contract and reproducible black-box observation it derives from.
- [ ] 我有权提交全部内容，并同意该贡献按 Apache-2.0 许可提供。 / I have the right to submit every included item and agree to provide the contribution under Apache-2.0.
- [ ] 本变更不包含来源或许可不明的代码、测试、文档或媒体。 / This change contains no code, tests, documentation, or media with unclear origin or licensing.
- [ ] 我没有提交 token、OAuth code、cookie、凭据、私人响应、原图或机器专属秘密。 / I did not submit tokens, OAuth codes, cookies, credentials, private responses, source images, or machine-specific secrets.
- [ ] 新行为有针对性测试；中英文用户文档和 CHANGELOG 已同步（如适用）。 / New behavior has focused tests; Chinese and English user docs plus CHANGELOG are synchronized when applicable.
- [ ] `pnpm run check` 通过，并在上方写明真实网络/平台验收边界。 / `pnpm run check` passes, and real-network/platform acceptance boundaries are stated above.
